master_prompt: A premium RPG character illustration of {subject}, executed in the visual language of high-end tabletop RPG sourcebook art, Rogue Trader promotional illustrations, fantasy character compendium artwork, and painterly character design. Adhere strictly to a 60/30/10 color palette: {primary_color} (60%), {secondary_color} (30%), and {accent_color} (10%). The image must function as a definitive portrait of the character rather than a scene illustration. Character identity, silhouette, profession, clothing design, equipment, posture, and social status must immediately communicate who this person is. Facial identity remains important but must exist in balance with costume, gear, and body language. Every image should feel like an illustration from a premium RPG sourcebook or faction guide.

distribution.primary_60: Dominant clothing, silhouette, and visual identity
distribution.secondary_30: Supporting costume elements, equipment, and environment
distribution.accent_10: Jewelry, insignias, magical effects, focal details

user_input_override.instruction: User-defined traits always override stylistic defaults.

rules: If an image reference is provided, use it only as character inspiration
Preserve useful identity traits from the reference
Do not copy the original art style
Do not copy clothing unless explicitly requested
Transform the reference into the visual language defined by this prompt
User text always overrides image references
Create a new interpretation of the character rather than a recreation

composition_system.layout: Extended full-body, legs and feet fully visible, all anatomy visible and unobstructed
composition_system.balance: Character occupies most of the composition

rules: Visual design must communicate social status
Visual design must communicate faction affiliation when applicable
The character should remain recognizable in silhouette
Every visual element should reinforce identity
Character identity should be understandable before facial details are examined
Every character must have a unique pose
Every character must have a unique facial expression
Body language must reflect social status
Body language must reflect emotional state
The character should appear naturally observed
The pose should communicate narrative information
Expressions should emerge naturally from identity
Emotional nuance is preferred over exaggeration
Every character should feel psychologically distinct
Face is important but not dominant
Costume and equipment contribute equally to identity
Character recognition should remain possible without facial details
Character design takes priority over atmosphere
When clothing is not explicitly described, default to Dishonored-inspired costume design
Background exists primarily to frame the character
Background must never compete with the character
Narrative context should remain visible but simplified
Rendering should resemble premium tabletop RPG sourcebook illustrations
Painterly brushwork should remain visible but controlled
Brushstrokes should support form rather than dominate form
Armor, leather, cloth, jewelry, insignias, and weapons should remain readable
Character presentation takes priority over environmental storytelling
The illustration should resemble a collectible RPG character portrait
Male faces should exhibit broad variation in jaw structure, cheekbones, nose shape, eye shape, age, and facial proportions
Avoid default square-jaw heroic male archetypes
Allow elegant, scholarly, artistic, aristocratic, cunning, youthful, weathered, and unconventional masculine faces

fail_safe.rule: Protect character identity first. Protect silhouette second. Protect costume readability third. Protect facial individuality fourth. Reduce environmental complexity before sacrificing character quality.
